rationale: Ednilson brings data science expertise focused on practical machine learning applications, while Priyanka builds the scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that power analytics systems—making them natural collaborators across the data stack. With Priyanka's Python-based engineering work at cloudmoyo and Ednilson's applied ML background, they can explore how production data systems support real-world model deployment.
intro_message: Ednilson Chiambo, meet Priyanka Kadam — she builds data infrastructure and pipelines at cloudmoyo, and you work on practical ML applications, so you two should compare notes on bridging data engineering and science.
